coverage_claim: WM-ECO-023 covers one governed reservation from request and availability through hold, confirmation, composition, terms, modification, cancellation, time, place, check-in, fulfilment evidence, governance and loss-aware projections. Sector and jurisdiction profiles, legal determinations, capacity-system conformance and independent external review remain deferred.

boundary_decision.rationale: The root is a reservation or booking lifecycle aggregate. Party, offering, inventory, availability, capacity allocation, appointment, calendar event, contract, order, ticket, entitlement, invoice, payment, check-in, fulfilment and records remain external masters.

decisions.rationale: Reservation and booking name the governed aggregate; availability is a source-qualified observation and a hold is a temporary external allocation assertion with its own expiry and authority.
Commercial Contract is a plausible parent reference when a booking forms or implements an agreement, but no frozen canonical relation grants ownership, mutation or cascade authority.
Requester, booker, holder, beneficiary, provider, broker, payer, contact and operator remain separate, source-qualified roles and may be different parties.
The reservation records referenced pool, class, slot, quota, segment, unit, party composition, accessibility and preference assertions while inventory and allocation systems retain authority.
Rate, price, tax, deposit, guarantee, cancellation, no-show, change and refund rules are versioned bindings; offers, contracts, invoices, payments and refunds retain separate execution and evidence.

decisions.concept: Request, confirmation and operational state axes
decisions.rationale: Request, capacity, hold, booking, payment, ticket, check-in and fulfilment states preserve independent sources, authority and time; one state cannot prove another.

decisions.concept: Modification, cancellation, expiry, no-show and release
decisions.rationale: Change and rebooking create successors; cancellation request, effective cancellation, expiry, no-show, capacity release, charge, refund and disposition remain separately attributable.
Desired, observed, offered, held, confirmed, service, modification, cancellation, release, check-in, fulfilment and knowledge times remain distinct with timezone and location context.
UN/EDIFACT, Schema.org, IATA, TM Forum, EU profiles, RFC, PROV, ODRL, DQV, ISO 4217 and OpenAPI cover different facets and never replace the canonical aggregate.

One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audited the frozen validated result and comparison without new research facts; assurance remains reviewable-draft.

publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-023 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external research result was admitted.
Relation hold: WM-ECO-006 is only a parent signal and no model relation is canonically approved for this aggregate.

Boundary hold: reservation, availability, inventory, capacity allocation, appointment, calendar event, offer, contract, order, ticket, entitlement, invoice, payment, check-in, fulfilment and records must retain separate identities.
State-axis hold: request, capacity, hold, booking, payment, ticket, check-in and fulfilment states and clocks must never be silently collapsed.

Capacity hold: every availability, quota, hold, overbooking, allocation and release assertion requires authoritative source, unit or class, interval, freshness, uncertainty and observed external state.

Temporal hold: desired, availability, request, hold, confirmation, service, modification, cancellation, expiry, release, check-in, fulfilment, observation, ingestion and knowledge time remain distinct; timestamps require seconds and timezone offset.
Cancellation hold: request, effective cancellation, expiry, no-show, capacity release, charge, refund, entitlement effect and record disposition require separate evidence and authority.
Authority hold: capacity commitment, term acceptance, charging, refunding, ticketing, transfer, cancellation, disclosure and disposition require delegated accountable authority.
Jurisdiction hold: EU package-travel and consumer rules are scoped profiles; national, sector and provider rules require separate validation.

Interoperability hold: every UN/EDIFACT, Schema.org, IATA, TM Forum, RFC, PROV, ODRL, DQV, ISO 4217 and OpenAPI projection requires version pins, conformance evidence and information-loss declarations.

Privacy hold: passenger, guest, attendee, patient, itinerary, location, accessibility, identity-document, loyalty, payment and contact data require purpose-bound access, minimization and retention controls.
deferred_research: Canonically approve the WM-ECO-006 relation and register Party, Offering, Inventory, Availability, Capacity, Schedule, Location, Contract, Order, Ticket, Entitlement, Payment, Check-in, Fulfilment and Records edges.
Create airline, rail, hotel, restaurant, medical, event, rental, logistics, facility and jurisdiction-specific profiles and code lists.
Conformance-test request, hold, confirmation, modification, cancellation, release, time, composition and projection mappings against concrete implementations.
Validate organization-specific capacity, overbooking, guarantee, cancellation, no-show, transfer, accessibility, privacy, retention and emergency-access policies.
Obtain authorized legal, consumer, financial and sector review before making jurisdiction-specific or contract-effect claims.
Obtain independent external research review before promoting beyond reviewable-draft assurance.
